scope: development-only worst-domain and hard-pair Prithvi scene-ranking experiment

folds.selection_training_rule: for each held selection fold, train only on the other two selection folds
folds.audit_training_rule: fit the frozen winner on folds 2/3/4 and score folds 0/1 once
folds.holdout_status: folds 0/1 are a reused audit after predecessor experiments, not independent confirmation

training.features: 768 frozen Prithvi CLS features plus augmented v3 scene/context features plus the OOF site-relative spatial logit
training.target_adaptation: source and each unlabeled target fold use independent per-feature mean and standard deviation
training.domain_groups: source fold by sensor by class
training.site_weighting: each physical site receives equal total base weight; positives receive square-root class balancing

search.rank_rule: stability, worst selection-fold AP delta, combined AP delta, matched-FPR recall delta, then smaller blend

gates.selection: combined AP and matched-FPR recall nonnegative, every fold AP positive, fold recall no worse than -0.002, both sensors no worse than -0.0025 AP, and paired-site AP lower bound positive
gates.reused_holdout_audit: the frozen winner passes the same point/fold/sensor rules and paired-site AP lower bound on folds 0/1

research_basis.method: group distributionally robust optimization with regularization
direct AUC optimization for imbalanced classification

invariants: No fresh CloudSEN or exact paper input is loaded.
The model capacity, optimization settings, pair-weight grid, blend grid, seeds, and gates are fixed before training.
Hard negatives are selected only inside each source training split.
Unlabeled target features affect only target normalization, never fitting or candidate selection labels.
Failure writes no artifact or score cache and blocks external scoring.
